Lecture 08 / Reinforcement learning

Learning from interaction and bandits

The RL problem, sampled experience, and exploration versus exploitation in multi-armed bandits.

Planned date Nov 10, 2026Proposed outline

Learning objectives

  • Distinguish planning with a model from learning through interaction.
  • Implement simple action-value estimates for a bandit.
  • Explain exploration and evaluate an exploration strategy.
